title: The tour was excellent....
text: The tour was excellent. Beattiz, the Tourist Guide has a vast knowledge of the City and its history and attractions. It was a great experience to have shared with her during this day. We recommend it in 100%.
author: Giovan_H

title: PHENOMENAL
text: A fantastic experience. It was a full day, a visit to everything you need, with some exquisite tapas. They took us to Casa Morales, a charming place. I recommend it
author: 606germanz
